lines: As lamp-light, rays, and sun disclose
direction and division — so by power, Śiva, O dear.
sanskrit_cite: yathālokena dīpasya kiraṇair bhāskarasya ca | jñāyate digvibhāgādi tadvac chaktyā śivaḥ priye

lines: God of gods, trident-marked, skull-adorned —
void of direction, place and time: designation-free.
sanskrit_cite: devadeva triśūlāṅka kapālakṛtabhūṣaṇa | digdeśakālaśūnyā ca vyapadeśavivarjitā

lines: What full-formed state of Bhairava is got, by which
means his door, O Goddess? Tell as you rightly know.
sanskrit_cite: yāvasthā bharitākārā bhairavasyopalabhyate | kair upāyair mukhaṃ tasya parā devi katham bhavet | yathā samyag ahaṃ vedmi tathā me brūhi bhairava

lines: Breath above, life below, the emission-natured —
uttering forth: at two arising places, filled, standing.
sanskrit_cite: ūrdhve prāṇo hy adho jīvo visargātmā paroccaret | utpattidvitayasthāne bharaṇād bharitā sthitiḥ

lines: Of wind within or outside, sky-pair not turning —
by Bhairavī, of Bhairava thus: the manifested form.
sanskrit_cite: maruto 'ntar bahir vāpi viyadyugmānivartanāt | bhairavyā bhairavasyettham bhairavi vyajyate vapuḥ

lines: Neither should it go nor enter, wind-blossomed power:
by thoughtlessness in middle — Bhairava-formness, by her.
sanskrit_cite: na vrajen na viśec chaktir marudrūpā vikāsite | nirvikalpatayā madhye tayā bhairavarūpatā

lines: Kumbhaka-held or exhaled or inhaled, whenever so —
at its end this is calm: by power, calm shines forth.
sanskrit_cite: kumbhitā recitā vāpi pūritā vā yadā bhavet | tadante śāntanāmāsau śaktyā śāntaḥ prakāśate

lines: From root ray-shining, from subtle subtler-natured:
contemplate her at twelve's end — calming, Bhairava's rise.
sanskrit_cite: āmūlāt kiraṇābhāsāṃ sūkṣmāt sūkṣmatarātmikam | cintayet tāṃ dviṣaṭkānte śyāmyantīm bhairavodayaḥ

lines: Rising lightning-formed, wheel by wheel in step;
upward three fists — until: then at end, great rise.
sanskrit_cite: udgacchantīṃ taḍitrūpām praticakraṃ kramāt kramam | ūrdhvaṃ muṣṭitrayaṃ yāvat tāvad ante mahodayaḥ

lines: Twelvefold course rightly, twelve letters divided;
through gross, subtle, supreme: freed at end — Śiva.
sanskrit_cite: kramadvādaśakaṃ samyag dvādaśākṣarabheditam | sthūlasūkṣmaparasthityā muktvā muktvāntataḥ śivaḥ
